authority: Only manuscript II-VIII, agreed clarifications, R-016/017/027/028 and existing durable contracts

ownership.manager: committed signed nonce-bound ordered current reads, separate head and history
ownership.verifier-A/B: distinct audiences/public request keys/service identities/stores; complete stored context, nonce tombstone, operation outcome and head

transaction: Request registration precedes bounded request signing. Exact consume checkpoint/outcome/head transaction commits before ACCEPTED. No atomic manager/verifier transaction.
freshness: Final manager reply retrieved at admitted current state; update before final read rejects, after retrieved read does not retroactively invalidate acceptance; final local strict expiry rechecked.
proof: Default unsupported; tests alone inject existing ControlledProofAdapter for exact canonical X/token. No proof of credential authenticity, knowledge or private non-revocation.
recovery: Independently retained exact HeadTicket plus writer permit; stale/corrupt/cross-audience denies, consumed survives; ordinary replay UNKNOWN.
redelivery: Not permitted for verifier acceptance by existing SQLiteStore.publish; retained CONSUMED outcome is metadata, not a second acceptance/business action.
fault_model: Injected exceptions, concurrent threads; earlier actual verifier pre/post-consume crashes reused without rerun. No new process crash or local private-relation evaluation.
